messages:
Ana (eng): Quick q — planning a 3-month remote stint in Nairobi, Kenya (May 15 -> Aug 15). Do I still qualify for the WFH stipend while I’m abroad? Any payroll/tax nexus stuff I should pre-flag? cc @Tess :flag-ke:
Tess (People Ops): Hey Ana — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: stipend can apply but only with pre-approval. Biggest items are payroll and local tax triggers. Can you confirm employment type (FT/contractor) and whether you'll be doing any client-facing work from there?
Ana (eng): Full-time Redwood, no client travel or local contracting planned. Just remote work from a co-work for deep focus. Using company laptop + VPN.
Mike (infra): From infra side, no production routing to Nairobi planned — you'll be fine for dev work. Watch for increased latency if you hit eu or us regions frequently. Not a blocker, just FYI.
Tess (People Ops): Actionable next steps: 1) People Ops to run a quick tax nexus check with payroll vendor 2) Legal to confirm whether >90 days triggers additional obligations 3) If payroll/vendor flags it, we may need a temporary payroll setup. I’ll open the payroll ticket. @Raj can you advise on SSO/VPN impacts? :mag:
Raj (security): @Tess yep — recommend keeping your official homebase as US in Workday and filing a Temporary Location form. Changing homebase temporarily can trigger security revalidation for SSO/VPN and benefits mapping. No blocker but it’s extra steps.
Tess (People Ops): Also need to check benefits coverage abroad (health/telemedicine), and whether local Kenyan law needs reporting if you stay >90/183 days. I'll loop in Benefits + Legal.
HR Bot: Policy excerpt: "Temporary remote assignments (<90 days): notify People Ops 30+ days prior; stipend exceptions require pre-approval; payroll change required if stay >183 days." See internal: https://redwood.internal/policies/remote-travel
Ana (eng): Thanks — I'll submit the Temporary Location form today and include exact travel dates + confirmation re: no client-facing activities. Will @mention you, Tess. :thumbsup:
Tess (People Ops): Great — once form is in I’ll kick off the payroll/vendor check. Plan: aim to close payroll confirmation within 5 business days. If payroll/legal blocks stipend we'll work through a one-off exception process. Please attach passport/visa notes if you have any questions about entry/visa status.
